items.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
items.body: U.S. inflation has stayed elevated for years, raising concern at the Federal Reserve that consumers may come to expect stubbornly high prices.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
items.body: The consumer price index was expected to increase 0.6% in September on a monthly basis and 3.6% from a year ago, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

items.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
items.body: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.

items.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
items.body: Economists expect the consumer price index for September to rise 0.6% on the month and 3.6% year over year.

items.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
items.body: France opens debate on its 2027 budget as high deficits, rising debt and student protests intensify pressure on lawmakers.

items.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
items.body: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

items.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
items.body: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
items.body: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.
